notes.zh: 全新界面。音箱没报出来的到账会标成“需要核对”。可选三种播报方式：音箱、手机、音箱和手机一起。可读取通知，和短信双重确认。交易记录按日期筛选，可导出 Excel。新增个人往来名单，可切换音箱语言。
notes.en: New design. Payments the speaker didn't announce are marked to check. Choose who announces: the speaker, the phone, or both. Notifications double-check M-Pesa SMS. Records by date, with Excel export. Personal list, and the speaker's language.
notes.sw: Muundo mpya. Malipo ambayo spika haikutangaza yanawekewa alama ya kukagua. Chagua anayetangaza: spika, simu, au zote mbili. Arifa zinathibitisha SMS za M-Pesa mara mbili. Rekodi kwa tarehe, na kutuma kwa Excel. Orodha binafsi, na lugha ya spika.
